manifest:
format: repo-standards/v1
name: mira-service-standards
description: Operational readiness for small services
requires:
  repo-standards: ">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"
defaults:
  declarations: {}
profiles:
  service:
    description: Operated service with a project-specific runbook
    declarations:
      editor-settings:
        checks: []
        fixes: []
        kind: file
        target: .editorconfig
        exact: files/editorconfig
      operations-guide:
        checks:
          - id: operational-evidence
            run:
              executable: node
              script: operations/check-operations.mjs
              resources:
                - operations/required-sections.json
              arguments: []
            prerequisite:
              version-arguments:
                - --version
              version: ">=24.0.0 <25.0.0"
            timeout-seconds: 10
        fixes:
          - id: initialize-status
            run:
              executable: node
              script: operations/initialize-status.mjs
              resources: []
              arguments: []
            prerequisite:
              version-arguments:
                - --version
              version: ">=24.0.0 <25.0.0"
            timeout-seconds: 10
        kind: repository
        guidance: guidance/operations.md
        targets:
          paths:
            - docs/operations.md
            - docs/operating-status.json
          directories: []

docs/operations.md.content:
# Harbor operations

Contact the platform on-call engineer for incidents. This demonstration service
has no authentication and must stay on loopback until a separate security review.
